name: Shift SnapCopy for WPBakery
author: shiftinnovation

sections.description:
WPBakery Page Builder can copy and paste one element at a time. Shift SnapCopy adds what is missing when you build pages for real:

  • Cut sections, rows, columns and elements, not only copy them.
  • A clipboard stack: copy several pieces, then paste them all together.
  • Copy the content of a column, or of a section, without the container itself.
  • Export and import the clipboard as a JSON file. Strings exported by some older clipboard add-ons can be imported too.
  • The same buttons in the backend and in the frontend editor.
  • Your own preferences: choose whether Copy replaces or adds to the clipboard, and hide the buttons you do not use (Settings → Shift SnapCopy).

Shift SnapCopy is an add-on: it needs WPBakery Page Builder 6.11 or later, which is sold separately. Translated into Italian, German, Spanish and French.
sections.installation:
1. Make sure WPBakery Page Builder 6.11 or later is installed and active.
  2. Upload the plugin to /wp-content/plugins/shift-snapcopy, or install it from the Plugins screen.
  3. Activate it. The toolbar appears in the WPBakery editor.
sections.faq:
I used another clipboard add-on before. Can I keep my clipboard?

Often, yes. If your previous add-on stored its clipboard in the browser under vcc_ keys, the first time you open the page builder its items and its “hide Cut” and “hide Export/Import” preferences are copied to Shift SnapCopy. Strings exported from it can be imported from the clipboard menu. Shift SnapCopy only reads that data: it never changes or removes it, so the other add-on keeps working if you still use it.
sections.changelog:
1.0.1

  • Data of other clipboard add-ons is now only read, never changed or removed.
  • Clearer wording about importing from other clipboard add-ons.

1.0.0

  • First release.
  • Copy, Copy+, Cut and Paste on every section, row, column and element, in the backend and the frontend editor.
  • Clipboard stack with a navbar menu: paste at the end of the page, remove single items, clear.
  • Copy the content of a column, and optionally of a section.
  • Export and import the clipboard as a JSON file.
  • Per-user preferences in Settings → Shift SnapCopy.
  • Copies the clipboard and preferences of an older clipboard add-on on first use.
  • Translations: Italian, German, Spanish, French.
